name: Yes Be Yes
overview: Scripture calls believers to unwavering honesty and integrity in their speech, emphasizing that truthful communication delights the Lord and reflects our unity as members of Christ's body. The call to 'let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay' underscores the importance of straightforwardness without oaths or deception, as anything beyond simple affirmation or denial is rooted in evil. God's people are instructed to reject lying and to uphold truth in their relationships and judgments, demonstrating faithfulness to God and neighbor alike.
